page.meta_description: Funazushi is still made around Lake Biwa: fish packed in rice and salt for months, the sour relic of sushi before vinegar shortcuts. Related pages: Narezushi.
page.content:
Shiga narezushi of nigorobuna carp, a living fermented ancestor.

What is Funazushi?
